• ** Ravi Shankar is famously known as the sitar maestro in India.**
 
• He was a legendary musician and composer who was born in **Varanasi, India** in **1920 **and passed away in **2012.**
 
• **Shankar** was known for popularizing** Indian classical music** in the **West** and was a major influence on the** "psychedelic"** rock music of the **1960s.**
 
• He collaborated with a number of **Western musicians, including George Harrison of The Beatles,** and was awarded several prestigious awards during his **lifetime, including the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award**.
 
• **Shankar **is regarded as one of the most important figures in the history of Indian classical music and his legacy continues to influence musicians around the world.

• ** Maharshi Patanjali **was a revered ancient Indian sage who is believed to have compiled the **Yoga Sutras, a collection of 196 aphorisms that provide guidance on the practice and philosophy of yoga.**

 
 
• The exact date of Patanjali's birth and death is not known, but he is believed to have lived in India during the** 2nd century BCE or earlier.**
 
• Patanjali is also revered as the founder of** classical Ayurveda, a system of traditional medicine that emphasizes the balance of body, mind, and spirit.**
 
• In addition to his contributions to **yoga and Ayurveda**, **Patanjali** is also known for his commentary on the **Sanskrit grammar of Panini, known as the Mahabhashya.**
 
• Patanjali's teachings have had a profound impact on the spiritual and philosophical traditions of India, and his legacy continues to influence millions of people around the world today.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan was a legendary Indian musician who is widely regarded as one of the finest shehnai players of all time.**
 
 
• He was born in **1916** in the small town of **Dumraon in Bihar, India,** and grew up in the city of** Varanasi,** which is known for its rich musical heritage.
 
• Khan began playing the shehnai, a traditional **Indian wind instrument**, at a young age and quickly gained a reputation for his skill and virtuosity.
 
• He went on to become one of the most celebrated musicians in India, performing for audiences around the world and receiving numerous awards and accolades for his contributions to music.
 
• Khan was also known for his dedication to preserving and promoting traditional Indian music, and he played a key role in popularizing the shehnai as a solo instrument.
 
• He passed away in 2006 at the age of 90, but his legacy continues to inspire and influence musicians around the world.
 
 
 
• **Sitara Devi was a renowned Indian classical dancer who specialized in Kathak, a North Indian dance form that emphasizes footwork, facial expressions, and storytelling.**
 
 
• She was born in **1920 in Kolkata, India**, and was raised in a family of **musicians and dancers**.
 
• **Devi **began performing as a child and quickly gained a reputation as a talented and** charismatic dancer**.
 
• She went on to become one of the most famous and respected dancers in India, performing for audiences around the world and receiving numerous awards and accolades for her contributions to dance.
 
• **Devi** was known for her** dynamic and expressive performances**, as well as her tireless efforts to promote and preserve traditional Indian dance forms.
 
• She passed away in **2014 at the age of 94**, but her legacy as a pioneer of Indian classical dance continues to inspire generations of dancers and dance enthusiasts.
